_meta.title: prompt, baked per pose by plan_qwen_frames

inputs.prompt: Image 2 is a coloured stick-figure pose skeleton. Draw the woman from image 1 standing in that exact pose, at the same size and position in the frame as the skeleton, with empty background around her: her whole figure fits inside the frame, hair, both shoes and both hands fully visible with margin on every side. heel dig: right leg stretched out on a forward diagonal with the right heel on the floor and the toe up, weight on the bent left leg, chest proud and leaning back slightly, left fist on the hip, head turned toward the right foot. Her right hand grips a long billiard cue that stands on the floor beside her like a dance pole. Sides are her own: she faces the viewer, so her left is on the right of the picture. She keeps her slim upright adult build, warm brown skin, an oval face with fine smile lines and a calm knowing smile, neat silver chin-length bob, small gold stud earrings, crisp ivory blouse with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, fitted billiard-green waistcoat with brass buttons, high-waisted charcoal trousers with a sharp crease, polished oxblood brogues and thick dark ink outline, exactly as in image 1. Same pixel art style with crisp pixel clusters and cel shading. She has exactly two arms and two hands, each hand complete with fingers. Both eyes are open. This is a grown woman of about sixty, fully clothed. There is exactly one billiard cue, long, slim, straight and rigid, with a pale wooden shaft, a white tip and a dark wooden butt: it lies along the thin white line in image 2. Do not draw the line itself. Do not draw the skeleton. Plain light grey background, full body.
